blocks.orig: Step into a tropical paradise right on the east coast of Zanzibar, where the Natural Park Village Resort offers a wonderful white sand beach and mesmerizing sunrises over the turquoise Indian Ocean every morning.
blocks.html: A tropical paradise awaits on Zanzibar's east coast: the Natural Park Village Resort has a gorgeous beach of white sand, and each morning you can watch captivating sunrises above the turquoise Indian Ocean.

blocks.orig: Here, you experience the spirit of Zanzibar in two-story fully equipped villas that can accommodate five to seven people. Each villa has its own kitchenette, bedrooms with bathrooms, furnished terraces, and a spacious living room. Decorated with locally handmade furniture, the villas blend with the surrounding nature with their facades lined with coral stone and roofs covered with elephant grass. A common swimming pool is available for refreshing dives, and of course, the ocean is just a few steps away. Those preferring not to cook can indulge in freshly prepared dishes as the restaurant offers a wide choice of local cuisine with aromatic herbs and spices as well as international delights.
blocks.html: You get to experience the spirit of Zanzibar in fully equipped two-storey villas sleeping five to seven people. Every villa has its own kitchenette, bedrooms with bathrooms, furnished terraces and a roomy living room. Furnished with locally handmade pieces, the villas fit into the natural surroundings, with facades of coral stone and roofs thatched with elephant grass. There is a shared swimming pool for a refreshing dip, and the ocean is of course only a few steps away. If you would rather not cook, the restaurant serves freshly made dishes, with a broad choice of local cuisine full of aromatic herbs and spices as well as international favourites.
